events.title: Sparkle & Sip
events.description: The NRL finals are here and we’re getting ready to cheer in style.Join us at The Lord Alfred for a jersey bedazzle session hosted by Eleyna Benzenati, aka Your Sports Girlie. Bring your NRL jersey and get it game-day ready with plenty of sparkle for the finals game.For $45pp, you’ll get all the bedazzling items you need, grazing boards to share and a drink on arrival.Bookings are essential, so grab your mates and get ready to sparke and sip.
